plugins.name: HelloDino
plugins.description: The minimum viable plug-in: one command (prints a greeting and drops a point at the origin) and one Dino Flow node. Start here if you are writing your first plug-in.
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project

plugins.name: MeshTools
plugins.description: Procedural mesh generation: a TerrainMesh command that builds a full heightfield grid via add_mesh(), paired with a Dino Flow node that samples the same height function.
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project

plugins.name: CurveTools
plugins.description: A parametric curve generator: a helix command via add_polyline(), paired with a Dino Flow node returning a point on the same helix at parameter T.
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project

plugins.name: AnalysisTools
plugins.description: Multi-object, read-and-write command I/O: reads the selection and each object's bounding box, prints a report, and writes results back as user text - plus a generative Fibonacci-sphere point-distribution Dino Flow node.
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
